verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents Devin ingesting security alerts (e.g., code-scanning or dependency alerts), validating them, and opening remediation pull requests. The closest items are adjacent: Devin Review Auto-Fix handles code review comments and CI failures, and MCP integrations connect to tools like Sentry, but neither is a security-alert remediation workflow.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can have security alerts automatically validated and remediated with an opened pull request
